For direct OKX v5 REST scripting:

## 1. Key endpoints

| Purpose | Endpoint | Example instrument |
|---|---|---|
| Spot candles, recent | `GET /api/v5/market/candles` | `BTC-USDT` |
| Spot candles, older history | `GET /api/v5/market/history-candles` | `BTC-USDT` |
| Current funding rate | `GET /api/v5/public/funding-rate` | `BTC-USDT-SWAP` |
| Funding history | `GET /api/v5/public/funding-rate-history` | `BTC-USDT-SWAP` |

Base URL:

```text
https://www.okx.com
```

These are public endpoints, so no API key is required.

Important: funding is not a spot-market field. Spot pairs like `BTC-USDT` do not have funding. Funding belongs to perpetual swaps, e.g. use `BTC-USDT-SWAP` for BTC/USDT perpetual funding.

---

## 2. Spot candles

### Recent candles

```bash
curl "https://www.okx.com/api/v5/market/candles?instId=BTC-USDT&bar=1H&limit=100"
```

### Historical candles

```bash
curl "https://www.okx.com/api/v5/market/history-candles?instId=BTC-USDT&bar=1H&limit=100"
```

Common params:

| Param | Notes |
|---|---|
| `instId` | Spot instrument, e.g. `BTC-USDT`, `ETH-USDT` |
| `bar` | `1m`, `5m`, `15m`, `30m`, `1H`, `4H`, `1D`, etc. |
| `limit` | Page size. Recent candles commonly allow up to 300; history commonly up to 100. |
| `after` | Fetch older records than the given timestamp. |
| `before` | Fetch newer records than the given timestamp. |

Candle rows are returned newest-first and values are strings.
